$note: Music library. `bytesized-theme` is the channel theme used under every short. Generate it once with `npm run audio -- bytesized-theme` on a paid plan and reuse it forever. `licensed` gates final renders.

bytesized-theme.prompt: Playful, upbeat instrumental tech-explainer theme for short vertical videos. 112 BPM, bright major key, bouncy muted synth plucks and marimba hooks over a light lo-fi drum groove with crisp claps and soft kick, warm round bass, subtle glassy arpeggios, a curious and clever mood, like a friendly animated diagram coming to life. Steady energy the whole way through, no big drops or build-ups, no vocals, leaves space for a voiceover, clean ending.
